_comment: STUDY B1 — seasonal structure. Every class is seasonal, so 'is it periodic' carries zero label information; the model must read WHICH periodic structure. This is the experiment H1 is actually built for: a periodic signal in a delay embedding closes into a loop, and these four classes differ in how that loop is shaped. single_seasonality = one period (30); multiple_seasonality = two nested periods (30 and 4) and therefore a loop with substructure; sarma = stationary seasonal ARMA; sarima = seasonal unit root, so the loop drifts instead of closing. NOTE: with betise 0.4.0 defaults, per-series std ranges from ~0.2 (single_seasonality) to ~5.7 (sarima) — a 25x scale gap that raw amplitude alone would separate. Per-series z-normalisation before topology extraction is mandatory here; see CLAUDE.md.
